mapper.select: , stages AS ( SELECT 'LAND_CLEARING' AS stage, 1 AS stage_order UNION ALL SELECT 'FOUNDATION', 2 UNION ALL SELECT 'FRAMING', 3 UNION ALL SELECT 'MEP', 4 UNION ALL SELECT 'INTERIOR', 5 UNION ALL SELECT 'CO_READY', 6 ) SELECT s.stage, COUNT(h.id) AS house_count FROM stages s LEFT JOIN house_snapshot h ON h.stage = s.stage GROUP BY s.stage, s.stage_order ORDER BY s.stage_order
